name: clickable-svg-vscode
description: SVG viewer that supports clickable relative links to open files in VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Show a warning and do nothing when an SVG link points to an http/https URL.
Open http/https links in the system default browser.
clickableSvg.externalLinkPolicy.markdownDescription: How `http`/`https` links inside SVG previews are handled. In Restricted Mode, links always stay blocked.

clickableSvg.blockAbsolutePaths.markdownDescription: When enabled, SVG links that use absolute filesystem paths (e.g. `/etc/passwd`) are blocked. Relative links and workspace traversal rules still apply when disabled. In Restricted Mode, absolute paths always stay blocked.

clickableSvg.blockSchemeLinks.markdownDescription: When enabled, non-http(s) URI schemes are blocked. When disabled, only `file:`, `mailto:`, and `tel:` may open (via the extension host). `vscode://` and `command:` are **always** blocked. In Restricted Mode, all scheme links stay blocked regardless of this setting.

enumDescriptions: Never allow inline scripts in the SVG preview (no prompts). Safest.
Prompt once per session when an SVG contains scripts; widen CSP only if you confirm.
Always allow inline scripts in the SVG preview. Unsafe for untrusted workspaces.
clickableSvg.scriptPolicy.markdownDescription: How embedded `<script>` tags inside SVG previews are handled. **permissive** is unsafe if you open SVGs from untrusted sources. In Restricted Mode, scripts never run (`strict` behavior).
